title.full: Finding Healthier SG stations and clinics

summary.text: Use GoWhere to find your nearest enrolment station or check whether your GP or polyclinic participates.

steps.name: Open GoWhere
steps.text: Open https://gowhere.gov.sg/healthiersg to check for your nearest Healthier SG Enrolment Station and participating clinics.

steps.name: Enter a search
steps.text: Enter your postal code to find the nearest station, or enter your clinic's name to check if it participates.

example_phrasings: Where is the nearest Healthier SG Enrolment Station?
How do I check if my clinic takes part?
Can I find a participating GP or polyclinic near me?

sources.page_title: Where is the Healthier SG Enrolment Station nearest to me? How can I check if my GP / polyclinic is participating in Healthier SG?
